Subject: Supplier identity & routing — initial info request

Hi Samira,

Thanks for engaging with Redwood. To complete our vendor record and enable PO routing and payments, can you please provide the items below? If you have a single supplier packet (PDF) that contains everything, thats great — otherwise attaching separate documents is fine.

Required fields (please reply to this thread):
- Legal / company name to appear on the vendor record
- Entity type (Corp / LLC / Partnership) and state/country of registration
- Tax ID / EIN or VAT ID and tax residence
- Registered address (line1, line2, city, state/province, postal code, country)
- Invoice remit email and any separate AP inbox (preferred invoice address)
- Preferred PO channel: Email, EDI (identifier), Ariba/SAP supplier ID, or Redwood vendor portal
- Payment currency and standard payment terms (Net30/Net45/etc.)
- Bank details (bank name, account holder, IBAN/ACH routing or SWIFT) — can be provided as a secure attachment
- Contact for invoicing (name, role, phone) and contract/legal contact for signature matters
- Copies of certs/forms: W-9 or W-8BEN (if outside US), company registration, and any reseller/subcontractor disclosures

Optional but helpful: DUNS, HubSpot company ID, preferred vendor code for your ERP.

If youd prefer to upload to our secure vendor portal instead of email, I can send a one-time link. We generally aim to have vendor records created within 3 business days once we have the core docs; payments follow after AP verification and bank validation.

Thanks — looking forward to the packet.

-Karthik
